'''5H-0T''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Shopkeeper droid/Legends|vendor droid]] selling his wares in the [[Training Room (Jedi Temple)|Training Room]] of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]], using [[Coruscant Mission Token]]s as a [[Currency/Legends|currency]].

==Behind the scenes==
5H-0T first appeared in "[[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)]]" as a gear vendor in the Jedi Temple training room, using Coruscant Mission Tokens as a currency. The name 5H-0T resembles the word "shot".
